label: GO step choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial (first ~70 trials of the episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and almost only when the agent is about to pick a2 (99% of mass; model_act==2 works just as well, so this is the agent computing its own choice, not reading a future variable). It needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (96% of mass). It also depends on time in the episode: it fades after about trial 60 and is silent after trial 80, so ep_trial < 70 lifts precision from 0.56 to 0.81 (dev F1 0.81, mass recall 0.95). Magnitude builds over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 choices (e.g. 0.57 -> 0.79 -> 0.91 -> 0.97 of max). It tracks the strength of the a2 policy logit (choice < -4 scores a similar F1, 0.82). Remaining activations are weak (about 0.03-0.3 of max), at a2 GO steps after a rewarded trial. It does not fire when choosing a1, at fixation or state steps, or late in the episode.

issues: Systematic false-positive class: the label says 'choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial', but when that unrewarded previous trial was an a1 choice (a lose-switch from a1 to a2), the feature is almost silent. The original predicate restricted to prev_action==1 gives test precision 0.21 on 5578 predicted steps (about 10% of all predictions) and covers only 0.9% of activation mass. In the profile, prev_action==1 holds 0.9% of mass and prev_action==2 holds 81% (the rest is the window's first trial, where prev_action is unknown). The feature fires when the agent repeats a2 after an unrewarded a2 trial (lose-stay on a2), not on any a2 choice after no reward.
Excluding prev_action==1 raises test precision from 0.794 to 0.859 and test F1 from 0.803 to 0.824, while mass recall stays at 0.94. Dev F1 goes from 0.808 to 0.826.

The claim that 'choice < -4 scores a similar dev F1 of 0.82' leaves out conditions. choice<-4 at GO alone gives dev F1 0.40, and adding ep_trial<70 gives 0.52. It reaches 0.82 only when prev_reward==0 and ep_trial<70 are also added. So the policy logit alone does not explain the feature; the unrewarded history is needed.

Claims that check out: the feature fires only at GO (100% of mass); 99% of mass is on a2 choices; model_act==2 scores the same as action==2 (test F1 0.802), so it is not a future variable; prev_reward==0 holds 96% of mass; it fades after about trial 60 (2 active steps in trials 80-89, 0 in 90-99); misses are weak a2 GO steps after a rewarded trial (5% of mass); the good state does not drive it (precision 0.78 when S1 is good, 0.90 when S2 is good).
